brief: Goldman Sachs FICC and Equities derivatives desk update, 2 September 2026. The desk reports a sharp implied vol reset, with NDX average stock implied vol down about 20 vol points since mid-July to near YTD lows, which it attributes to improved AI sentiment and recent leverage reduction and positioning unwinds. That reset has produced a bid for tech upside across single stocks and index, and at the same time a noticeable uptick in hedging ahead of a seasonally more challenging period for equities and renewed geopolitical tensions. The desk's conclusion follows from both: pair optimistic tech views with portfolio hedges while near-term vol is at these levels. Ideas listed: buy AMAT calls, buy QQQ calls, fund SMH upside by selling IGV upside, buy VIX 21Oct26 20/30 call spreads as a book hedge, buy IWM calls into Friday's NFP where GS is below street consensus, GLD/IBIT/SPX worst-of calls for the debasement theme, and cross-corridor dispersion. Dealer gamma is estimated still very long and getting longer to the downside, a source of index support. Client flow cited: DKS September calls and EWZ December call spreads.
